title: Talk about an Activity You Have Tried

source.rights: 项目原创虚构教学材料；AI 编写并对照教学规则、原文和题目证据复核。
source.reviewScope: Ordinary A2 practice. Exact source contexts and answers reviewed; synthetic en-US audio checked for file integrity, decoding, role/segment alignment and unprompted ASR content. Pronunciation and intonation are not independently certified.

instructions: Prepare briefly, then record your own answer. Speak for 90–120 seconds and use at least six lesson words.
prompt: Describe a sport or hobby you have tried or would like to try. Explain your experience, the equipment you need, and whether you prefer practicing or watching. Speak for 90–120 seconds and use at least six lesson words.
reference: I have tried several activities in my leisure time, but my favorite hobby is volleyball. I first played it with friends last year at a small gym. I have never joined a serious competition, and I do not worry much about the score. I enjoy exercise more when everyone helps the team. A coach showed us how to pass the ball safely, and the center provided the equipment. I have also watched a match as a spectator, which gave me some ideas for practice. I would like to cycle to the gym next time, so I will wear a helmet. My goal is to improve my fitness and enjoy time with friends.
